chapter: Family and the lake excursion boats
title: Dejan on the Madisonville and Susquehanna boats
summary: Dejan played the Madisonville and then the Susquehanna, and recalls good business. Wooden Joe and a white band also played the boats.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: I never played on it. I remember I never played on it. I never played on it. I played from outside, you know, private parties and big doctors on the big yachts and I stayed a long time on the Mazzinville. Then I left Mazzinville and then I went on the Susquehanna.
Yeah, so Wooden Joe I know used to play on it. I think you used to have a white band on it too. Raymond Burke tells about it. He used to play on it sometimes too.
Oh, business was good then, man. Sometimes people be standing at the walk waiting for you to land.
You all playing tonight? Can't you come play

with me tonight? You know, like that. You turned your house down and you couldn't make it. And I said, ma'am, that is Cherie. That is the man of presence. Yeah, and later on, later on when Tio left then he started carrying Adolf Alexander on alto and then a Cherie on tenor. Sometime at a Cherie he would play his E-flat clarinet. Sometime he felt like it.
